explainer.importance: frozen target confidence minus confidence after single-cell occlusion
explainer.target_match: same exact class, unique match, original-box IoU >= 0.50
explainer.ranking: descending positive confidence drop; row-major tie break
explainer.random_control: one deterministic permutation seeded from SHA-256(target_id)

curve_settings.baseline: Gaussian-blurred image; sigma=max(3 px, round(1% of the shorter image edge))
curve_settings.deletion: replace top-ranked cells in original image with blurred-baseline pixels
curve_settings.insertion: start from blurred baseline and restore top-ranked cells from original image
curve_settings.score: same-class matched target confidence; zero only when the target detection is absent
curve_settings.normalization: clip confidence / verified baseline confidence to [0,1] for AUC; preserve raw confidence
curve_settings.auc: trapezoidal integration over actual modified pixel-area fraction
curve_settings.interpretation: lower deletion AUC and higher insertion AUC are better; compare against random and inverse controls
